units: design units, y down, cap top y=0, baseline y=cap, ink-left x=0

common.threshold: cv2.THRESH_OTSU + THRESH_BINARY_INV (dark ink = foreground; the r4 strip is luminance-inverted first)
common.fitting: corner split + chord-length least-squares cubic + 3 Newton passes + recursive max-error split; 0.24 source px for digits/labels, 0.10 source px for the 27 px plus; acceptance cap 0.25
common.normalisation: ink left -> x=0; cap top -> y=0; baseline -> y=cap; one scale per sheet; overshoot preserved
common.contours_format: list of closed cubic contours, outer first then holes; each segment is [sx,sy,c1x,c1y,c2x,c2y,ex,ey]; first point not repeated

digits.threshold: cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV + cv2.THRESH_OTSU on 4x INTER_CUBIC grayscale (dark ink = foreground)
digits.contours: cv2.findContours RETR_CCOMP + CHAIN_APPROX_NONE; outer + child holes grouped per glyph
digits.fitting: corner split, chord-length LSQ cubic, 3 Newton passes, recursive split at max error, tolerance 0.24 source px (acceptance cap 0.25)
digits.normalisation: one scale 60.7/cap_px; baseline -> y=60.7 (y down); cap top -> y=0; ink left -> x=0; overshoot preserved
digits.acceptance: final rounded contours re-rasterised at 4x in the sheet's original position vs each glyph's own 4x Otsu connected component; supplementary 4x->1x INTER_AREA downsample IoU

labels.contours: cv2.findContours RETR_CCOMP + CHAIN_APPROX_NONE, outer+children grouped by row/x
labels.fitting: corner split, chord-length LSQ cubic, 3 Newton passes, recursive split at max error, tolerance 0.24 source px (acceptance cap 0.25)
labels.normalisation: baseline -> y=77.69 (y down), ink left -> x=0, scale=77.69/cap_px

plus.polarity: inverted luminance (light ink on dark sheet), then THRESH_BINARY_INV + OTSU
plus.cap: primary scale uses the owner-known 36.25 px cap; the same-method Otsu flat-letter cap measures 36.0 px, a 0.7% scale difference reported in the sensitivity field, not silently applied
plus.advance: width + 2 * median(measured label side bearings in the same units)

derivation.note: row 2 has no flat glyph; cap top and baseline are derived from the row-1 measured overshoot and cross-checked against the 172 px cap

7.advance_basis: terminal: ink width + 2 * median measured side bearing (extrapolated)

0.advance_basis: terminal: ink width + 2 * median measured side bearing (extrapolated)

terminal_5.note: the terminal row-2 5 is extrapolated; the canonical 5 is the row-1 5 whose 5->G advance is measured

G.advance_basis: extrapolated from the median measured side bearing (no G->x pair)

E.advance_basis: extrapolated from the median measured side bearing (no E->x pair)

3.advance_basis: 3->4 ink-left advance (measured; used as the 3G advance, successor not G)

+.advance_basis: width + 2 * median measured label side bearing; the G->+ spacing has no direct measurement (r4 G is a different instance from the r10 canonical G)

provenance.why: the r10 label sheet has no plus; this is the SF reference strip that defines the r9 label shapes. The plus is the only glyph taken from it; the r4 G and the r4 spacing are not used as r10 label data.

groups.formula: sum(advances of all but last) + last ink width, ink-left advances

notes.5G+: G->+ spacing has no direct measurement; the plus advance is derived from the median measured side bearing and is flagged extrapolated. The r4 strip does place a plus after a G (G ink-left 348.5, plus ink-left 388.5), but that G is not the r10 canonical G, so the pair is not used as r10 advance data.
notes.3G: the 3 advance is measured as 3->4, not 3->G; it is the best measured proxy and is flagged in the glyph entry.

notes.canonical_5: the canonical '5' is the row-1 '5' from '5G' (advance 5->G is measured). The terminal row-2 '5' is a separate traced instance; its advance is extrapolated (see instances, id row2-5-5) and it is not used as the canonical glyph.
notes.terminal_5: row2-5-5 is the terminal 5; advance extrapolated from the median measured side bearing and flagged in instances.
notes.g_and_e: the canonical G and E advances are extrapolated from the median measured side bearing; no G->x / E->x pair exists on the sheet.
notes.plus: the plus is shape-only data from the r4 SF strip; its advance is derived and flagged.
notes.label_digit_independence: label glyph '5' and digit '5' are separate data; see the independence block.

five_comparison_at_digit_cap.method: both normalised to ink-left x=0 and cap top y=0; the label 5 is scaled from cap 71.4 to 60.7 and compared as dense outlines (the segment counts differ, so a pairwise control-point difference is not defined; the symmetric outline distance is the max coordinate difference of the two shapes)
